title: Split Gauss coordinates give an explicit Koszul--Tate contraction

koszul_tate.algebra: Finite-rank smooth cylindrical functions that are polynomial in finitely many Gauss-coordinate components g_a and odd antighost components b_a, with arbitrary smooth dependence on the transverse and matter coordinates
koszul_tate.differential: delta b_a=g_a and delta g_a=0, extended as an odd derivation; delta^2=0
koszul_tate.euler_operator: N=sum_a(g_a partial_(g_a)+b_a partial_(b_a)) counts positive Gauss/antighost degree on each finite cylindrical block
koszul_tate.homotopy: h=N^(-1) sum_a b_a partial_(g_a) on positive N-degree and h=0 at N=0
koszul_tate.contraction_identity: delta h+h delta=id-iota pi, where pi sets g=b=0 and iota restores the resulting function on the Gauss surface
koszul_tate.cohomology: Positive antighost homology vanishes and degree-zero homology is the cylindrical function algebra on G^-1(0)
koszul_tate.global_reason: K1415 makes g a global linear constraint coordinate, so the contraction has no partition-of-unity or local-rank qualification
koszul_tate.boundary: Exactness is proved for the declared smooth cylindrical/polynomial Koszul algebra. It is not a theorem for every local functional completion, distributional observable algebra or quantum operator domain
